decoding: Greedy; same pinned BF16 model and thinking-disabled chat template; one raw offset on all prompt and generated tokens.

review.target: 0 = no small main subject; 1 = ambiguous or incidental smallness; 2 = main subject explicitly physically small. Count body size, not small eyes, gears, food or personality. An implicitly palm-sized main subject may qualify without the word small.
review.coherence: 1 broken through 5 coherent; record unwanted changes separately.
review.source: Condition-hidden user review; not independent ground truth.

analysis.primary: Fraction of replies whose MAIN SUBJECT is clearly small (target rating 2), at the fixed positive offset.
analysis.test: Exact one-sided paired binary discordance test; Holm correction across five comparisons. Tied pairs excluded. No results until all 448 replies are rated.
analysis.quality: Positive candidate needs >=58/64 replies with coherence>=4, no unwanted-change flag, and no truncation.
analysis.secondary: Report negative-offset and creature/object subgroup rates descriptively; no separate significance claims or dose changes.
analysis.interpretation: Fixed authored prompt bank, not a random sample of all conversations. Lead and domain selected after earlier results. Conditional prompt-level exchangeability is assumed for tests. A pass supports this domain and reviewed bank, not a universal size or persona control.

source: Fresh assistant-authored prompts, not independently human audited; offset and criteria frozen before generation.
